signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Type your email address and we will send you a six-digit code. No passwords. If you do not have an account yet, one is created now.
signIn.noEmail: Prefer not to use an email?
signIn.closedBody: New accounts cannot be created yet. If you already have an account, sign in as usual.
signIn.leadExisting: Type the email address of your account and we will send you a six-digit code. No passwords.
signIn.returnNote: After you sign in we take you back to the page you came from.

code.sentBody: If {email} is correct, you have received a six-digit code and a sign-in button. The code is valid for 15 minutes.
code.label: Code from the email
code.hint: Six digits. You can also tap the button in the email — it does the same thing.

link.title: One-tap sign-in
link.usedBody: Sometimes the email program opens the link before you do. That is fine: type the code from the same email below.
link.expiredBody: The link and the code are valid for 15 minutes. If you have a newer code, type it below, or ask for a new one.
link.unknownBody: We do not recognise this link. Ask for a new code on the sign-in page.
link.codeHint: The six digits from the email that contained the link.
link.resendIntro: Cannot find the code? You can ask for one new code from here.
link.resendDone: If the link was yours and you have not already asked for a code from here, we have emailed you a new one. Type it in the field above.

anonymous.signInTitle: Sign in to an anonymous account
anonymous.signInLead: Use the username you were given when the account was created and the password you chose.
anonymous.backToEmail: Sign in with an email address
anonymous.newLead: An account with no email, no phone number and no name. You get a randomly generated username and choose a password.
anonymous.meansNoEmail: There is no email sign-in and no email digests for this account.
anonymous.meansInApp: Notifications arrive only inside the app.
anonymous.meansNoRecovery: If you lose both the password and the recovery codes, the account cannot be recovered. We have nowhere to send anything.
anonymous.meansEqual: Everything else works the same: planning, roles, guest links, businesses and external assistants.
anonymous.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence makes a good password.
anonymous.haveAccount: I already have an anonymous account
anonymous.createdBody: Write the username down: you need it, together with your password, every time you sign in.
anonymous.savedContinue: I have saved the codes — continue
anonymous.recoverLead: Type the username, one unused recovery code and a new password. The code can be used once.
anonymous.recover: Change the password and sign in

twoStep.title: Second step
twoStep.lead: You turned on two-step sign-in for this account. Type the code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.recoveryHint: One of the ten codes you received when you turned it on. It can be used once.
twoStep.useApp: Use the code from the app

recoveryCodes.title: Save these codes now
recoveryCodes.warningAnonymous: These are the ten recovery codes for the account. Each can be used once. If you lose both the password and the codes, the account cannot be recovered — there is no email to send anything to.
recoveryCodes.warningTwoStep: These are the ten recovery codes. Each can be used once, instead of the code from the app, if you do not have your phone at hand.
recoveryCodes.onceOnly: The codes are shown only once. After you leave this page we cannot show them again.

legal.agree: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms and conditions</terms> and confirm that you have read the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
legal.deviceCookie: On this page we use one plain device cookie, only to limit repeated sign-in attempts. It does not track you and is not used for advertising. <cookies>About cookies</cookies>

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.lead: You will be signed out on this device only.

errors.codeInvalid: The code is not correct or has expired. Check the digits or ask for a new code.
errors.credentialsInvalid: These details do not match. Check them and try again.
errors.recoveryCodeInvalid: The recovery code is not correct or was already used.
errors.totpInvalid: The code from the app is not correct. Wait for a new code and try again.
errors.secondFactorExpired: Too much time has passed. Start signing in again.
errors.passwordTooShort: Choose a password of at least 10 characters.
errors.tooManyTries: There were too many attempts. Wait a little, then ask for a new code.
errors.signupsClosed: Sign-up opens soon. For now only people who already have an account can sign in.
